tables.name: ef_club_summaries
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE "ef_club_summaries" (
    "Id" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "GameWorldId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Name" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "DivisionTier" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "CashBalance" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "LeaguePoints" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "BuiltCapacity" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "UsableCapacity" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "ConditionPercent" REAL NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "PK_ef_club_summaries" PRIMARY KEY ("GameWorldId", "Id")
)

tables.name: ef_financial_ledger
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE "ef_financial_ledger" (
    "Id" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_ef_financial_ledger" PRIMARY KEY,
    "GameWorldId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "ClubId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "SeasonNumber" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "RoundNumber" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "Category" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "Amount" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "BalanceAfter" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Description" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "IdempotencyKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "CreatedAtUtc" TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: ef_season_histories
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE "ef_season_histories" (
    "Id" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_ef_season_histories" PRIMARY KEY,
    "GameWorldId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "SeasonNumber" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "FirstDivisionChampionClubId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "FirstDivisionChampionName" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "CupChampionClubId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "CupChampionName" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "TopScorerPlayerName" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "TopScorerGoals" INTEGER NOT NULL
)

tables.name: ef_worlds
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE "ef_worlds" (
    "Id" TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT "PK_ef_worlds" PRIMARY KEY,
    "Name" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "InviteCode" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "Seed" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "TotalClubs" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "SeasonNumber" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "RoundNumber" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "RoundState" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "RoundVersion" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "CurrentMatchMinute" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "SnapshotJson" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "CreatedAtUtc" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "UpdatedAtUtc" TEXT NOT NULL
)
